title: Alix Earle Makes Headlines in Bold Wet Fit for Brand Launch - NewsBreak
text:
By Evolve Editors ,
1 hours ago Photo Credit: TheStewartofNY/GC Images via Getty Images Alix Earle is setting the Internet on fire with her brand launch video, which she recently posted online. While the fans were excited to know all about her line, Reale Actives, it was her wet fit that set many hearts racing.
Alix Earle debuts wet fit in Reale Actives brand launch video Alix Earle looks jaw-dropping gorgeous in her wet fit for Reale Actives launch. Look at the clip here:
Akix Earle recently shared the happy news with her fans about her product, which is “clinically proven” and has helped her transform her “complexion” and “confidence” as well. While the fans were beyond excited to know about the product, they were also smitten by her looks in the video, where she flaunted her curves in a skin-colored wet fit.
After watching the clip, a person confessed, “Actually can’t stop watching this video btw. You’re phenomenal!” Another individual also committed the same and mentioned, “You slay so hard.” Many netizens even admitted they can’t wait to try her product. “Congratulations I can’t wait to try!!,” said a follower, with another saying, “N D.”
Originally written by Parul Singh on Reality Tea .
